command:
set -eu
if ! id opsadmin >/dev/null 2>&1; then useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash opsadmin; fi
generated_password=[REDACTED] rand -base64 48)
printf 'opsadmin:%s\n' "$generated_password" | chpasswd
unset generated_password
install -d -m 700 -o opsadmin -g opsadmin /home/opsadmin/.ssh
printf '%s\n' 'ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAINMKA2+oNHxgmpABaV61Sar8lVW2YxSL8Aw9d7b5yLh1 os-comparison@example.invalid' > /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
chown opsadmin:opsadmin /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
chmod 600 /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
if command -v restorecon >/dev/null 2>&1; then restorecon -RF /home/opsadmin/.ssh; fi
printf '%s\n' 'PubkeyAuthentication yes' 'PasswordAuthentication no' 'KbdInteractiveAuthentication no' 'AuthenticationMethods publickey' > /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-key-only.conf
chmod 600 /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-key-only.conf
sshd -t
systemctl reload sshd
printf 'change_applied=yes\n'
